text: Scans git repositories (including full history) to find hardcoded secrets, passwords, and keys
quote: TruffleHog™ is a secrets scanning tool that digs deep into your code repositories to find secrets, passwords, and sensitive keys.

text: Classifies over 800 distinct secret types and maps each back to the identity it belongs to
quote: trufflehog classifies over 800 secret types, mapping them back to the specific identity they belong to

text: For classifiable secrets, can actively log in to the issuing service to confirm if the secret is still live
quote: for every secret trufflehog can classify, it can also log in to confirm if that secret is live or not

text: Can be run as a git pre-commit hook to stop secrets from ever being committed
quote: Pre-commit hooks are a useful way to prevent secrets in code from being pushed from a git repository.

text: Supports a custom regex-based detector definition with optional webhook-based verification
quote: The custom regex detector allows you to define your own detector using regular expressions with optional verification using a webhook.

text: CLI flag lets users manually pick which detectors run (e.g. only AWS, GitHub)
quote: You can manually specify which detectors to use with the `--include-detectors` flag.

text: CLI flags let users force-enable or force-disable verification per detector, overriding source defaults
quote: this trufflehog invocation will force verification for AWS and Buildkite secrets, irrespective of whether the configured sources have their verify flag set

text: Installable via Homebrew as an official CLI package
quote: brew install trufflehog

text: Onboarding flow connects a source and streams findings into a web UI
quote: By the end, you'll have a running scanner, your first source connected, and findings flowing into the web UI.

text: Findings can be routed to Slack, Jira, email, or generic webhooks for notification
quote: Route findings to Slack, Jira, email, or webhooks so the right people can act on them.

text: Scans beyond git repos, including comments, Docker images, and other non-code artifacts
quote: TruffleHog scans beyond code repositories to identify secrets hidden in comments, Docker images, and more.

text: CLI supports a --fail flag so scans exit with a failing status when verified/unknown secrets are found, for CI gating
quote: trufflehog git file://. --since-commit HEAD --results=verified,unknown --fail

text: Can be run headlessly via Docker container against a GitHub org or repo
quote: docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD:/pwd" trufflesecurity/trufflehog:latest github --org=trufflesecurity

text: Supports a git server pre-receive hook that blocks commits containing secrets from being accepted at all
quote: If you run your own git server, consider the pre-receive hook option which can block commits with secrets from being accepted.

text: Continuously tracks status of previously found keys to detect whether remediation/rotation has occurred, with configurable alerts
quote: TruffleHog continuously tracks the status of all key types to identify whether remediation has occurred. Set up alerts across the platform of your choosing and include customized messages for developers to rotate and secure keys.

text: Hook installation can use git's core.hooksPath to apply pre-commit scanning across all repos without per-repo setup
quote: This approach uses Git's `core.hooksPath` to apply hooks to all repositories without requiring any per-repository setup

text: An 'analyze' mode inspects a leaked credential to determine who created it, what resources it can access, and its permissions
quote: TruffleHog Analyze evaluates access patterns to identify a secret’s metadata, permissions, and resources.

text: Can be deployed as a hosted (vendor-managed) or self-hosted scanner
quote: Deploy hosted or self-hosted scanners, scan your critical systems for secrets, and notify the right teams to remediate and rotate.

text: Can continuously monitor non-git SaaS sources like Jira, Slack, Confluence, Teams, and Sharepoint for leaked credentials
quote: Are you interested in continuously monitoring Git, Jira, Slack, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, Sharepoint (and more) for credentials?

text: Enterprise offering supports SAML 2.0/OAuth 2.0 single sign-on and role-based access control
quote: single sign on saml 2 0 or oauth 2 0 ❌ ✅ role based access control ❌ ✅

text: Release artifacts are checksummed and the checksum file is signed with cosign for supply-chain integrity
quote: Checksums are applied to all artifacts, and the resulting checksum file is signed using cosign.

text: GCP is supported as a target for the credential-analysis feature
quote: GCP analyze is currently supported.
